description: An exponential VCA whose output is extrapolated two samples into the future through a one pole filter

params.text: Sets the gain, -24dB at fully counter-clockwise, 0dB at a third of the way up and 6dB fully clockwise
Sets how far the CVdB input moves the gain; the centre of its travel is no effect and the two ends are equal and opposite
Sets the corner of the filter the extrapolation is taken through, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz

inputs.text: The signal the gain is applied to
Moves the gain on top of the gain knob at a tenth of a unit per volt, scaled by the modulation knob

outputs.text: The gained signal, filtered and extrapolated two samples ahead

notes: the output is not the input times the gain: it is a four term extrapolation of the filtered signal, so a sharp edge overshoots well past the level the gain would give it

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
